Dame las coordenadas de 2749704YJ0624N0001DI con longitud, latitud y fuente.
interface.longDescription: Look up public facts about a property in Spain using its cadastral reference. Get the recorded use, built area, parcel area and construction year when available, plus a reference point labelled as EPSG:4326 longitude and latitude. Link the official Cadastre sources and show which descriptive and coordinate services responded. Useful for checking property descriptions and preparing a cadastral fact sheet. The public lookup does not identify owners, certify title or boundaries, provide a market valuation or confirm planning permission. Navarra and the Basque Country use separate cadastral systems.
